name: image-preview
description: Real image previews in the transcript for pasted images and images Claude reads (kitty graphics protocol)

cellWidthPx.title: Cell width (px)
cellWidthPx.description: Width of one terminal cell in pixels: preview columns are derived from it, so the picture keeps its aspect

cellHeightPx.title: Cell height (px)
cellHeightPx.description: Height of one terminal cell in pixels: preview rows are derived from it, so the picture keeps its aspect
